about_the_game:
The future of the planet depends on a tiny seed – and its name is Looppip.

You control Looppip, a magical seed carrying an ancient hourglass with the power to turn back time. Your mission is to save the beehives—essential for life on Earth—and reverse the environmental collapse threatening nature.

                                                                   

Journey through four worlds devastated by destructive forces, where you'll face:

  • First World: Wildfires consuming vital habitats.

  • Second World: Air and water pollution poisoning the environment.

  • Third World: Aggressive industrialization choking nature.

  • Fourth World: Robots and artificial intelligence ignoring ecological balance.

Time-rewind mechanics as the core gameplay

Looppip has a unique power: by manipulating time, it can rewind up to 3 seconds into the past. This ability lets you escape traps, fix mistakes, and solve challenging puzzles. With the hourglass in hand, every second matters as you fight to protect the bees—key players in maintaining ecological balance.

Rescue seed friends… and plant them

Looppip is a seed that plants seeds. During your journey, you can rescue friendly seeds you encounter. These seeds become available in a special stage, where you can plant and grow them to unlock power-ups.

One game, two ways to play

Looppip is designed for both casual and hardcore players. If you prefer a relaxing experience, you can focus on solving puzzles and collecting coins. But if you seek a real challenge, the game offers that too.

Will Looppip manage to turn back time and save the future?
In Looppip, every rewind is a chance to restore nature.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-core de 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Placa integrada ou GPU com 512 MB de VRAM (como Intel HD Graphics)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Quad-core de 2.5 GHz ou superior
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU dedicada com 1 GB de VRAM (como NVIDIA GeForce GT 730 ou equivalente)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
